    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.count-up');

        const startCount = (element, targetValue, duration, suffix = '') => {
            let start = 0;
            const increment = targetValue / (duration / 16); // Calculate increment per frame (60fps)

            const counter = setInterval(() => {
                start += increment;
                if (start >= targetValue) {
                    start = targetValue;
                    clearInterval(counter);
                }
                element.textContent = Math.floor(start) + suffix;
            }, 16); // Update every ~16ms
        };

        counters.forEach(counter => {
            const child = counter.querySelector('p'); // Target the child element
            if (!child) return;

            const content = child.textContent.trim();
            const valueMatch = content.match(/^(\d+)/); // Extract numeric value
            const suffixMatch = content.match(/[\D]+$/); // Extract suffix (if any)

            if (valueMatch) {
                const targetValue = parseInt(valueMatch[1], 10);
                const suffix = suffixMatch ? suffixMatch[0] : ''; // Get suffix if it exists
                const duration = parseInt(counter.dataset.duration || '1000', 10); // Default duration 1s

                // Start the count-up animation when the element is in the viewport
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            startCount(child, targetValue, duration, suffix);
                            observer.unobserve(entry.target); // Stop observing after triggering
                        }
                    });
                });
                observer.observe(counter);
            }
        });
    });
